reviews.review: Great formula and foundations.  I hate the controls and graphics.  5/10

As a huge Risk of Rain 2 fan, I was worried that the first instalment wouldn't be as good as the sequel. However, this game has a very distinct style of play, and I would heavily suggest a RoR2 player to come back to this game as well for a variety of reasons.
First, the characters. It's true that the second game's characters are much more open, with customizable layouts and special passive abilities. However, there are some very interesting characters that thrive because of the 2d game style. For example, the character Sniper turns this rogue-like into a rhythm game. And Chef has fun synergies between his moves that I'm surprised didn't get into the sequel. 
Next, the stages. The fact that this game is 2d means that the maps are way more vertical, and that makes for a really cool feel to each stage. And they occasionally have a special challenge to get artefacts, which in my opinion is way more fun then getting artefacts in the sequel. At least, the ambry portion.
Finally, the gameplay. It has the same difficulty scaling as the second game, and the gameplay loop is much the same. The biggest macro change is the teleporter event, as you need to defeat each enemy and there is no teleport bubble (I know that sounds extremely annoying to play, but it's executed well so that you don't need to run around the stage looking for that last enemy). 
However, the actual micro play is a whole new experience. The 2d makes it so that the game is less focused on aiming, but more on positioning. The items are fun and unique, and there are a lot of cool enemies. And some enemies that aren't as cool (looking at you, archer bug). Nevertheless, each round has me interested. 
My only big gripe with the game is the multiplayer. It's super fun, but you need to go through this huge process to actually get it to work. However, if you're a lonely nobody, then you have nothing to worry about. 
So if you really like the sequel, I truly suggest you invest in this game as well. I will say that the sales greatly reduce the price (usually to about $1.50 CAD), so it might be worth it to wait for that. But this is a great game that I'll be sure to play for a while to come.

The game that got me into Roguelikes. One of the first games I 100% on Steam.

There's not a soul I played this game with that has not enjoyed it.

If you have never tried a Roguelike this is the perfect place to start.

You won't regret it.
